other_conditions: The proposed land must be near the applicant’s residence and consist of one, two, or three plots of “don” land.
The land proposed for pond construction must be undisputed and not mortgaged against any bank loan.
The applicant must have valid possession of the proposed land and provide the necessary documentation.
The applicant must be financially capable of contributing their share of the pond construction costs.
The applicant should be engaged in fish farming or have constructed a fish seed hatchery with a departmental subsidy.
At least 130 decimals of land are required for a 100 decimal water area, with a minimum water‑to‑land ratio of 1:1.3 for larger ponds.
benefits_summary: Provides financial assistance of up to 80% for SC/ST beneficiaries (maximum ₹4,00,000) or up to 70% for other categories (maximum ₹3,50,000) to construct one‑acre rearing ponds.
documents_required: proof of experience in fish farming
